excerpt.zh: 帝制派和[target.GetRulerTitle]的其他宵小之辈在每一个帝国成员国境内都占据着数量上的优势。线人在叛乱爆发的时候必须就位，一旦行动，就要控制住、亦或是直接抹除掉这些帝制派分子。
excerpt.en: Imperial loyalists and other lackeys of the [target.GetRulerTitle] are present in great numbers in each of the Imperium's member states. Assets need to be in place to immediately seize or otherwise neutralize these loyalists the moment the rebellion breaks out

texts.zh: 帝制派和[target.GetRulerTitle]的其他宵小之辈在每一个帝国成员国境内都占据着数量上的优势。线人在叛乱爆发的时候必须就位，一旦行动，就要控制住、亦或是直接抹除掉这些帝制派分子。
texts.en: Imperial loyalists and other lackeys of the [target.GetRulerTitle] are present in great numbers in each of the Imperium's member states. Assets need to be in place to immediately seize or otherwise neutralize these loyalists the moment the rebellion breaks out.

texts.zh: 星海帝国现已成功地撑过了席卷全境的暴乱风波！随着帝国重掌权威，公开叛乱的可能已经微乎其微。我们可以撤回特工了。
texts.en: The Imperium has somehow managed to weather the storm of turmoil and instability that was only recently sweeping across it! With Imperial authorities now firmly back in control, conditions are no longer favorable for an open revolt. Our operatives have been withdrawn.

label.zh: 我们现在应当等待时机……
label.en: We shall bide our time for now...
